errors.evidence: The orange line (On-policy RL) starts at a value of approximately 63.5, not 62.5, which is the minimum value on the y-axis.
The red line (LUFFY) starts at a value of approximately 76.0 at Temperature 0.1, not 78.0.
The line representing SFT is dark teal or green, not blue.
The markers for the SFT line are downward-pointing triangles, not circles.
This description of the SFT line's trend is an oversimplification. The line decreases from T=0.1 to 0.5, has a large spike at T=0.6, and then fluctuates, ending lower than its starting point.
